name: WebPros Dashboard (Remote)
description: Manage servers, domains, and resources connected to your WebPros Dashboard account. Provides tools for Plesk, cPanel, and WHM management through the hosted remote MCP server. Authenticates with a scoped MCP key.

inputs.label: WebPros Dashboard MCP Key
inputs.description: Scoped MCP key generated from your WebPros Dashboard profile. Grants the AI assistant access to the servers and resources in your Dashboard account.

obtain.instructions:
1. Log in to your WebPros Dashboard at https://dashboard.webpros.com
2. Navigate to Profile > API and MCP
3. Click Create MCP Key
4. Give the key a descriptive name
5. Copy the generated key

auth.instructions: Create an MCP key at https://dashboard.webpros.com under Profile > API and MCP. The key is sent as a Bearer token.
